title: Unslop AI UI
sourceNote: From the reel “How to unslop your designs”
summary: Start from a reference, strip the tells, choose fonts and colors yourself.

tutorials.title: Unslop in three moves
steps: Start from one or two reference sites
Run the checklist on every output
Pick fonts and colors yourself, lock them as a system

sections.title: Slop checklist
sections.intro: Remove or justify each one. Tick them off as you review.
items: Periods at the end of titles

sections.title: Briefing an AI
sections.text: Paste the reference screenshots, your font and color tokens, and this checklist as don’ts. Review the output against the checklist before accepting it. Pair with Design critique for hierarchy and color checks.

overview.purpose: Strip generic AI-slop styling from UIs, pages and decks made with AI.
overview.when: Reviewing an AI-made interface, or briefing an AI to make one.
takeaways: Start from a reference you like
Run the checklist on every output
Lock them as a small design system
